hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
### assume etl role aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3000 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
i="X" find data/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \;
mkdir -p data/dataset1 mkdir -p data/dataset2 mkdir -p data/output
echo "${dataset1_s3_location}${i}/" echo "${dataset2_s3_location}${i}/"
aws s3 sync "${dataset1_s3_location}${i}/" data/dataset1/ aws s3 sync "${dataset2_s3_location}${i}/" data/dataset2/
ls -l data/dataset1 ls -l data/dataset2
java -Xmx32g -jar docker/pic-sure-hpds-etl/GenomicDatasetMergerRunner-jar-with-dependencies.jar data/dataset1/ data/dataset2/ data/output/
ls -l data/output
### assume etl role unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 sync data/output/ "${temp_s3_location}${i}/"
for i in $(seq 1 22); do find data/ -type f -exec rm -rf {} \;
mkdir -p data/dataset1 mkdir -p data/dataset2 mkdir -p data/output
echo "${dataset1_s3_location}${i}/" echo "${dataset2_s3_location}${i}/"
aws s3 sync "${dataset1_s3_location}${i}/" data/dataset1/ aws s3 sync "${dataset2_s3_location}${i}/" data/dataset2/
ls -l data/dataset1 ls -l data/dataset2
java -Xmx32g -jar docker/pic-sure-hpds-etl/GenomicDatasetMergerRunner-jar-with-dependencies.jar data/dataset1/ data/dataset2/ data/output/
ls -l data/output
### assume etl role unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 sync data/output/ "${temp_s3_location}${i}/" done
aws s3 sync "${temp_s3_location}" "${output_s3_location}" aws s3 rm "${temp_s3_location}" --recursive
